test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

You must ______ what you cannot cure.
solution:
The correct answer is "endure."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The reason to use **"endure"** in the blank is that it emphasizes the idea of tolerating or bearing something difficult or unpleasant without trying to change it. (रिक्त स्थान में **"endure"** का उपयोग करने का कारण यह है कि यह किसी कठिन या अप्रिय चीज़ को बदलने की कोशिश किए बिना उसे सहने या सहन करने के विचार पर जोर देता है)
 
• In the context of the sentence,** "You must endure what you cannot cure,"** it suggests that if you cannot change or fix a situation, the best course of action is to accept it and bear through it patiently or stoically.
 
• This phrase conveys the notion of resilience and acceptance in the face of adversity or challenges.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

Correct sentence: *You must **endure**__ what you cannot cure.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Embracing: **to put your arms around somebody as a sign of love, happiness, etc. ((प्रेम, प्रसन्‍नता आदि से) आलिंगन करना, गले लगाना)
 
• **State: **to say or write something, especially formally. (कुछ कहना या लिखना (विशेषतः औपचारिक रूप से))
 
• **Take: **to carry or move somebody/something; to go with somebody from one place to another. (किसी को लेना या ले जाना; किसी के साथ कहीं जाना)
